list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Do not apply on broken or irritated skin. Patch tests are an easy way to ensure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: What is the difference between a deodorant and an antiperspirant?
list.content: Deodrants directly fight sweat-causing bacteria. Antiperspirants contain actives which reduce sweat by clogging sweat pores. These pores get unclogged naturally due to the skin renewal process.

list.title: Will it leave patches on clothes?
list.content: No, if you allow the product to absorb before wearing clothes, it won't leave patches.

list.title: Can I use it directly post-waxing?
list.content: We'd suggest keeping a gap of 6-12 hours to use this deodrant post waxing.

list.title: How much time will it take to see results?
list.content: We recommend checking with the doctor as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

list.title: Can I use this product twice a day?
list.content: Yes, you can use this product on clean skin, daily, twice a day.
